description: Implementation of CustomerOptionSetService for managing customer option sets, including listing, deleting, saving, and updating options within a shop management system.

classes.name: CustomerOptionSetServiceImpl
classes.description: Service class implementing business logic for customer option sets, including CRUD operations and queries.

methods.name: listByOption
methods.description: Retrieves a list of CustomerOptionSet filtered by a specific CustomerOption for a given MerchantStore.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a CustomerOptionSet based on its ID after fetching it from DAO.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Lists CustomerOptionSets available in a specific MerchantStore, considering the language.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves a new CustomerOptionSet or updates an existing one based on its ID.

methods.name: listByOptionValue
methods.description: Retrieves CustomerOptionSets associated with a specific CustomerOptionValue in a given MerchantStore.
